name: Kuramei Sprint 2 — Generative UI Engine
description: Close the loop: LLM generates a JSON spec, spec becomes an HTML page hosted on the edge, user receives a link on WhatsApp. Done criterion: send 'navegar para Campinas' → receive link that opens a map page in the browser.

userStories.title: Spec Schema — freeze NavigationSpec + Zod validator
userStories.description: As agent-processor, I want to generate a valid JSON spec for navigation intent so that the Renderer knows exactly what to render.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/ui-engine/ with package.json (@kuramei/ui-engine) and tsconfig.json
Create src/spec/schema.ts exporting: UISpecType, NavigationSpec (type, version, destination, departureTime?, avoidTolls?, preferredApp?), UISpec, UISpecToken (spec, userId, createdAt, expiresAt)
Create Zod validators for NavigationSpec and UISpecToken in the same file
Export all types and validators from packages/ui-engine/src/index.ts
Add @kuramei/ui-engine to pnpm-workspace.yaml (or infer from packages/* glob)
pnpm build passes — ui-engine compiles without TypeScript errors
Schema is frozen: no changes to NavigationSpec fields after this PR merges
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes
pnpm lint passes

userStories.title: Renderer — NavigationSpec → HTML page with navigation buttons
userStories.description: As a Cloudflare Worker, I want to transform a NavigationSpec into functional HTML so that the user sees a page with buttons to open the map.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/ui-engine/src/renderer/navigation.ts with a renderNavigation(spec: NavigationSpec, token: UISpecToken) function that returns an HTML string

Rendered page contains: formatted destination heading, 'Abrir no Waze' button → waze://?q={destination}&navigate=yes, 'Abrir no Google Maps' button → https://www.google.com/maps/search/?q={destination}, 'Abrir no Apple Maps' button → maps://?q={destination}
Rendered page shows expiration time remaining (formatted) when link is still valid
Rendered page shows 'Link expirado' message when expiresAt has passed
HTML is valid — no obvious structural errors
Responsive for mobile: CSS inline only, no external frameworks or CDN links
TypeScript pure — no runtime heavy dependencies
Export renderNavigation from packages/ui-engine/src/index.ts
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes
pnpm lint passes

userStories.title: Cloudflare Worker — routing, JWT validation, KV lookup, CSP
userStories.description: As a user who receives the link, I want to open ${KURAMEI_BASE_URL}/ui/{token} and see the correct navigation page so that I can navigate to the destination.
acceptanceCriteria: Create apps/ui-worker/ with: src/index.ts (entry, routing), src/renderer.ts (calls @kuramei/ui-engine renderer), src/validate.ts (JWT + Zod validation), wrangler.toml, package.json
Worker responds to GET /ui/:token
Worker extracts JWT from URL token, validates with KURAMEI_JWT_SECRET (Wrangler secret)
Invalid or expired JWT → elegant error page (not 500), with WhatsApp deep link: https://wa.me/{WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=Preciso+de+um+novo+link
Valid JWT → GET spec from KV using hash from JWT payload
Spec absent in KV (TTL expired) → 'Link expirado' page with WhatsApp deep link
Worker calls Renderer.render(spec) and returns HTML
CSP header present on all responses: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-src https://www.openstreetmap.org; style-src 'unsafe-inline'
wrangler.toml has KV namespace binding configured
pnpm build passes (all packages including ui-worker)
pnpm typecheck passes
pnpm lint passes

userStories.title: Tool generate_ui — Lambda writes spec to Cloudflare KV via REST API
userStories.description: As agent-processor, I want to execute the generate_ui tool to generate and store the spec so that the Worker can retrieve and render it when the user opens the link.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement generate_ui tool in @kuramei/tools package
Tool accepts NavigationSpec as input (validated with Zod)
Tool creates UISpecToken: spec + userId (hash of phone number) + createdAt (now) + expiresAt (now + 3600s)
Tool signs JWT HS256 with KURAMEI_JWT_SECRET: payload = { hash: tokenHash, exp: expiresAt/1000 }

Tool calls Cloudflare KV REST API to write spec: PUT https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}/storage/kv/namespaces/{CLOUDFLARE_KV_NAMESPACE_ID}/values/{key}?expiration_ttl=3600 with Authorization: Bearer {CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}
Tool returns URL: ${KURAMEI_BASE_URL}/ui/{token}
KV write failure → throws error that agent-client captures and responds to user
All 4 env vars documented in .env.example: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, CLOUDFLARE_KV_NAMESPACE_ID, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, KURAMEI_JWT_SECRET
KURAMEI_BASE_URL also added to .env.example
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes
pnpm lint passes
userStories.notes: Lambda (AWS) and Cloudflare KV are different clouds — MUST use Cloudflare KV REST API, not any binding. CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN goes in AWS Secrets Manager alongside KURAMEI_JWT_SECRET.

userStories.title: Pipeline end-to-end — WhatsApp → agent-processor → generate_ui → URL
userStories.description: As a Kuramei user, I want to send 'navegar para Campinas' on WhatsApp so that I receive a link that opens a navigation page.
acceptanceCriteria: Create apps/agent-processor/ Lambda (or confirm it exists) that: receives invocation from webhook-handler, resolves identity via PresenceService, loads/creates session in DynamoDB, calls AgentClient with tools
generate_ui tool registered in agent-processor's AppConfig tools list
System prompt instructs LLM to use generate_ui for navigation intents
Intent 'navegar para [cidade]' consistently detected by LLM and triggers generate_ui tool call
LLM called via OpenRouterProvider (DeepSeek V3 primary)
Agent sends WhatsApp reply with the URL (plain text message)
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes
pnpm lint passes
userStories.notes: If agent-processor app does not exist yet, create it following webhook-handler pattern. InvocationType: Event (async). No EventBridge.

userStories.title: Smoke test — local end-to-end without Lambda
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to test the Worker locally without needing a Lambda so that I can validate the UI Engine pipeline in isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/smoke-test.ts that: generates JWT + UISpecToken directly (no Lambda simulation), uses 'wrangler kv:key put --local {hash} {json}' CLI to write spec to local KV, mounts URL http://localhost:8787/ui/{token}, opens URL in browser automatically (macOS: open, Linux: xdg-open)
Add 'smoke-test' script to root package.json: 'tsx scripts/smoke-test.ts'
Running 'pnpm smoke-test' with 'wrangler dev' running opens the navigation page in the browser
Page displays 'Rota para Campinas, SP' with 3 navigation buttons (Waze, Google Maps, Apple Maps)
Test with expired token (set expiresAt in the past) → shows elegant error page (not 500)
Test with invalid JWT (wrong secret) → shows elegant error page (not 500)
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes
pnpm lint passes
userStories.notes: wrangler dev and Lambda run in separate processes — do not share memory. Smoke test must be independent of Lambda. Use KURAMEI_JWT_SECRET from .env.local.
